notes.title: 2.0.1 Fixes and new Followers
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [FIX] If the player triggers the Abyssal post-game content, Greater Drake sidequests in the skeleton maps are lost as the maps are destroyed. Not only does it make capturing those drakes impossible, but it also prevents the player from using Eliza's duplication feature to find legendaries in the wild (including the Abyssal Tyrants). The 4 destroyed maps now also contain the Greater Drake sidequests.
[*] SafeMode file loading (holding L+R for 10 seconds on a save slot) will now always teleport the player to the orphanage.
[*] [FIX] Since Eliza is gone after fighting Kroma, the player wouldn't get her hint on Venefelis' maze pattern. Her character now stays until the player beats Venefelis.
[*] Tyrant Byeol can now also spawn at the orphanage woods.
[*] [FIX] Nexomon without favorite meals: Deyam line, and Masquiti line.
[*] [FIX] It's possible to use the Portable Warpstone shortly after the Ignitia elevator attack sequence, letting the player re-take the elevator even thought it's not fixed yet, making them spawn in the middle of the lava. The Portable Warpstone is now disabled during this sequence.
[*] Desktop and Mobile: Added a Discord server invite button in the Settings menu.
[*] The inventory will prioritize the Portable Warpstone and Portable Storage items to appear higher on the list, for convenience.
[*] Minor collision fixes and misplaced grasses in the Abyssal region.
[*] Bonnie's dialogue to unlock the Tier-MAX cores in the Abyssal Region has been moved to the map with a giant boulder (north from camp).
[*] Furthermore, Bonnie's dialogue has been duplicated to other locations (but once you've talked to her, she disappears from all said locations):
-- ⦿ Near the frozen cavern.
-- ⦿ Near the cook camp.
-- ⦿ Entrance of dark maze.
-- ⦿ Inside the miners' cave.
[*] Several new followers added. They are only visible in the list if you have unlocked them:
-- ⦿ Meeting Atlas unlocks him as a follower.
-- ⦿ Winning the Cadium Arena unlocks Derek.
-- ⦿ Resurrecting Nivalis unlocks Lobo.
-- ⦿ Beating the main story unlocks Coco.
-- ⦿ Beating Volcel unlocks Ross.
-- ⦿ Learning to Lure unlocks Nora.
-- ⦿ Beating Kroma unlocks Eliza.
-- ⦿ Completing the main story, the post-game, every sidequest, and owning all 427 Nexomon, unlocks as a follower: Trashman. And also Ulzar.
[*] [FIX] Growth berries didn't reset the current EXP to zero.
[*] [FIX] Patch of grass in the Precursor Valley's dark maze was not reacting to the player.
[*] An alternative way to unlock Eliza's duplication feature is to beat the post-game.
[*] [FIX] Releasing an "unique" Nexomon would mark it as uncaught even if the player has duplicates. Now, it will only be marked as uncaught if the player truly doesn't have more instances of that unique Nexomon. This is not retroactive - if you accidentally released an unique Nexomon before this update, you will still need to catch it again.
[*] Cost of Growth Berries at the Friendship Shop reduced from 10 to 5.
[*] Feeding grapes to Moga will inflict Poison.
[*] [FIX] Abyssal Tyrant portraits during dialogues had low resolution.
[/list]

notes.title: Custom Mode
notes.content:
Big news, tamers!

Today we are bringing [b]Custom Mode[/b], a special game mode available after completing the game. With a Custom file, you'll be able to adjust all manner of settings for a very unique adventure!

Things like permanently fainting a Nexomon, randomization, adjusted difficulty and copying Nexomon from other files has been requested a lot, so we've put it all under this system.

A lot has changed since our last announcement - you might want to check our Discord server's #timeline channel (https://discord.gg/vVwktEU3FZ) for the most details, but a few things worth pointing out are:

[list]
[*]Added Japanese, Korean and Chinese Simplified languages.
[*]The Legendaries are no longer cosmic-locked. If you have completed all post-game sidequests you can speak to Eliza and ask her to spawn them in the wild!
[*]The Database now displays a small "swords" icon, which counts how many times you've defeated a monster. One of its purposes is to improve the cosmic chance for that particular Nexomon. One point per defeat, up to 607 meaning that the new best possible cosmic chance is 1 in 1000. Sadly this counter is not retroactive, your previous battles wouldn't be factored in.
[/list]

[h2]Custom Mode Settings[/h2]

[list]
[*] Copy a Nexomon Team from another Save File.
[*] Copy a Nexomon Storage from another Save File.
[*] Copy an Inventory and Wallet from another Save File. Some items won't be copied (such as charms).
[*] Randomize Starters:
[list]
[*] Only unevolved Nexomon.
[*] Include evolved Nexomon.
[*] Include evolved Nexomon and legendaries.
[/list]
[*] Randomize Wild Encounters:
[list]
[*] Scramble the official distribution (i.e. pools are moved around).
[*] Completely random from the entire roster (no distribution at all).
[/list]
[*] Randomize Tamer Parties:
[list]
[*] Keep the original evolution stage.
[*] Use an equivalent or greater evolution stage.
[*] Use any random evolution stage.
[/list]
[*] Mutate Tamer Parties:
[list]
[*] Every time a tamer is defeated, their party is re-randomized so each encounter is different ("Randomize Tamer Parties" must be enabled).
[/list]
[*] Allow Story Boss Randomization:
[list]
[*] Allow story-related enemies to be randomized when "Randomize Tamer Parties" is enabled.
[/list]
[*] Capture Restriction:
[list]
[*] Only the very first Nexomon encountered in each map may be captured.
[/list]
[*] Randomize Overworld Items:
[list]
[*] Randomize items found on the ground and in chests:
[/list]
[*] Randomize Ore Boulders:
[list]
[*] Randomize items found in ore boulders
[/list]
[*] Max Level:
[list]
[*] Disable level cap (actually it becomes 999).
[/list]
[*] Early Evolved Encounters:
[list]
[*] Allow evolved stages to appear in the wild even early on.
[/list]
[*] Increased Difficulty:
[list]
[*] Boost the overall level difficulty of all encounters, up to +90 extra levels.
[/list]
[*] Permanently Faint Nexomon:
[list]
[*] Fainted Nexomon cannot be restored. Losing the game causes this setting to be disabled so it can be played normally.
[*] Fainted Nexomon cannot be restored. Losing the game causes your save file to be [b]permanently locked[/b].
[/list]
[*] Limit Battle Items:
[list]
[*] Set a limit from 0 to 5 items that may be used in a battle.
[/list]
[*] Disable Shopping:
[list]
[*] You cannot buy or sell items.
[/list]
[*] Flee From Battles:
[list]
[*] Disable the Flee command.
[/list]
[*] Boost Coins (wild and tamer encounters):
[list]
[*] Up to 300%
[/list]
[*] Boost Experience:
[list]
[*] Up to 500%
[/list]
[*] Starting Level:
[list]
[*] Set the level of your starter. This also resets the level of any copied Nexomon from other save files. Up to lvl 90.
[/list]
[*] Recalculate Evolution Stages:
[list]
[*] Recalculate the evolution stage of any copied Nexomon (so if you reset their levels to something low, they should be tier 1). This setting would also cause them to evolve if their new level happens to meet the threshold.
[/list]
[*] Randomize Skills:
[list]
[*] Keep the original element.
[*] Completely random.
[/list]
[*] Randomization Seed:
[list]
[*] Affects random patterns. Changing this after the initial setup can cause duplicate skills to be learned.
[/list]
[*] Lock Settings:
[list]
[*] Disallow the player from changing these settings after the initial setup.
[/list]
[/list]
Curious? The Custom Mode beta has actually been live for about a week - check out some of what it can do in Gym Leader Ed's stream! (there may be story spoilers)

[previewyoutube=efkSSVISy-o?t=134;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Join our Discord![/h2]

As always, drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/bs659QD]Discord server[/url] and help shape the future of Nexomon!
JVemon

P.S. Custom Mode is also coming to consoles. It will take a while for it to be approved in every platform.

notes.title: Synergy Cores, Avatars, QoL improvements and lots of new items!
notes.content:
Hello tamers! A lot has changed since the previous post. These few days we've focused on bringing in lots of quality-of-life improvements and a bunch of new avatars. You can check the changes below, but we also wanted to talk about one important update to your gameplay experience:

[h3]Synergy Cores[/h3]
These new and expensive cores act similarly to EXP Shares. Equipping them to a Nexomon will let them copy a % of the EXP earned by all other team members without having to fight. What's more, if the other members are using EXP Cores, the Synergy Core will actually include that in its equation!

A few of these cores have been placed in chests near the orphanage to help new players familiarize themselves with this highly requested item. But crafting them is not easy, and you'll need plenty of shards of every type. Fortunately we also added new items such as the Ultra Pickaxe and Mining Goggles which will boost you in that regard.

The other relatively large change is the fact that we moved the points in the story in which evolved monsters start appearing. The "tier-2" monsters were showing up as soon as you finished the Hostages mission, and the "tier-3" right after saving Ignitia. It seems both points were premature.

So we've moved the "tier-2" trigger to saving Ignitia, and the "tier-3" to the completion of the Drake Isles chapter. However, tamers may continue using evolved forms early on, as it was deemed acceptable and beneficial for the game's difficulty.

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now sprint by holding the "cancel" button (L for keyboards, B for Xbox, Circle for PS4).
[*]It is now possible to sort all Storage Groups at once, which is useful for those trying to build something like a living dex. Simply use the Sort shortcut from the Homepage instead of inside a Group.
[*]You can now unequip all cores from the Team menu (L3/Minus button) while a Nexomon is selected.
[*][strike]Himalayan Salt[/strike] Crystals have begun growing in some remote areas. Breaking them will restore your party (saving a trip to the medic, which is useful early game), but they are relatively scarce and can take 15-20 minutes to respawn.
[*]The evolution level now appears in the database info window.
[*]It is now possible to cancel an evolution by pressing the Back button and confirming.
[*]You can now command your Nexomon to rest during battle with the RS/R3 button. This restores 15 stamina.
[/list]

[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Synergy Cores implemented. They will copy a % of the EXP received by the other team members. There are three tiers: 8% / 16% / 25%.
[*]Added "Running Shoes" item. Having it in your inventory will guarantee fleeing from battles. Note that this is unrelated to the sprinting function, which you can already do.
[*]Added Ultra Pickaxe item, which can yield 1-3 shards.
[*]Added Mining Goggles item, which lowers the shard respawn timer to 10-15 min (from 15-20 min).
[*]Added "Healthy Charm" items. For each charm, the party is restored by +3% HP per battle won. Only three charms exist via chests.
[*]Added "Workout Charm" items. For each charm, the party is restored by +3% Stamina per battle won. Only three charms exist via chests.
[*]Added "Cosmic Charm" items. For each charm, the cosmic odds improve by 50 points. Only five charms exist via chests. Therefore the new best possible cosmic chance is 1/1607 if you are lategame, own every monster and own all five charms.
[*]All of the new items can be found in chests. Synergy Cores are crafted in Bonnie's lab.
[/list]

[h3]Changes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Status effects should now be cleared when a Nexomon faints.
[*]The "trigger" for tier-2 monsters has been moved from the Hostages mission to Saving Ignitia.
[*]The "trigger" for tier-3 monsters has been moved from Saving Ignitia to completing the Drake Isles chapter.
[*]Rolled back to the original skill learning system (not cyclic anymore).
[*]Added a Skill Master NPC at various locations. She will let you relearn any unlocked skills for a fixed coin fee.
[*]A few Synergy Cores have been added via chests earlygame to familiarize new players with this new item that's apparently highly requested.
[*]Significantly improved apparition rates of wild Tyrants, Extincts and Wardens. Sampling a few areas the odds for each is now close to 2-3%.
[*]Added 10 new avatars to pick from.
[*]The rarity of a monster now appears during battle.
[*]Your starter can now be cosmic. Same rate as the wild monsters.
[*]A new tamer was added (Youtuber 'Sacred') in Drake Isles as we had promised to have him in the game. Players who already unlocked the beat-all-tamers achievements aren't affected.
[*]Tamers that have been beaten once won't trigger again on sight. Exception: bandits from the Frozen Tundra.
[*]The southern Laterian prison guard will now face north as his line of sight seemed confusing.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Spanish LATAM during an endgame scene that could freeze the screen in Drake Isles.
[*]Fixed grasses by the desert ruins, which had no encounters.
[*]Fixed a visual glitch in the database showing the "release" button overlapping the Nexomon's cores.
[*]Fixed various Cosmic models that were still using the regular textures, such as Reptomotor or Bomblasta.
[*]Fixed an area in Haunted Woods that could not be accessed. It is now possible to explore using the Wind power.
[*]Fixed "Green Sphere" which was not restoring Stamina.
[*]Fixed a <blank> dialogue message when rematching a tamer girl in the Haunted Woods.
[*]Fixed the exit in a frozen cave in Ignitia, which was spawning the player too far away.
[*]Fixed "Psy Field" skill, which was not inflicting Paralyze.
[*]Fixed a few monster description typos, such as Moonline's and Starckal's.
[*]Disabled Russian from being activated when the system settings are set to Russian. This language is not fully supported yet - will default to English instead.
[*]Fixed the rewards in "The Middleman" quest which were incorrect.
[*]The issue with "stuck" character portraits (e.g. Cooper) might be fixed now.
[/list]

[h3]About Skills...[/h3]

Due to the back-and-forth we've had with the skill learning system, it won't be surprising if the game prompts you to learn a skill that you've already seen before, or that you already have equipped. There wasn't a smooth way to perform this transition for existing players - however, if you need any skill adjustments, just speak to the Skill Master that can be found in various cities. She will help you learn previous skills.

As always, drop by our Discord server and help us shape the future of the game with your feedback!  https://discord.gg/bs659QD

-JVemon

notes.title: Balancing, Harmony, Skill-Learning and more!
notes.content:
Hello, beta testers! As always we are carefully reviewing your feedback.

The difficulty of Nexomon: Extinction has been a major concern of ours. We've been working hard on a major rebalance of the entire campaign - there is a lot going on in the latest update!

[h3]The Dynamic Difficulty[/h3]

The backbone of our open-world-like experience is how the wild and the tamers appear to grow stronger in response to certain actions (the majority being story-progression).

However, it appears we overdid it in our earlier versions of the game and some players felt like the environment was catching up to them way too quickly - it sometimes even felt like the wild encounters were magically being stronger than your party at all times no matter how much you trained.

We've adjusted our dynamic difficulty system to be a bit more relaxed and not grow so quickly - but keep in mind that our priority is still to achieve a challenging experience. We don't want an easy game and after playtesting we felt that this update strikes a good balance.

[u][b]However![/b][/u] If you were playing the earlier versions and were forced to grind a lot, then please understand that once this update is applied there is a chance that you will suddenly be overleveled compared to the immediate environment.

[h3]Harmony Stat[/h3]

We have introduced our first hidden stat, [b][i]harmony[/i][/b], which goes from 0% to 100%. Each victory will increase it by +1, and fainting will decrease it by -5. A maximized harmony stat can boost the EXP intake of your Nexomon by 35%.

At the moment this is the only use for harmony, but this stat may be opening doors for lots of new features. Some players have already suggested having specific Cores get rejected if harmony is low.

[h3]The Skill Cycle[/h3]

A common concern among players was that, if the environment grows stronger overtime, you may catch a Nexomon whose some best skills were "already lost" since they are learned at low levels rather than high (that's right, all skills are sort of equally viable, which means that the most damaging ones might actually be learned early).

For this reason we have revamped the skill learning algorithm. Each Nexomon has its own list of 16-or-so skills that they may learn in their lifespan: one every 2-3 levels. Once they reach the "end" of said list (e.g. at around lvl 40), they will simply start learning back from the beginning of the list.

This solves two issues:
[olist]
[*] No more skills are "lost" because so long as you keep leveling up you will eventually repeat the cycle.
[*] This allowed us to "compress" the learning curve to one skill every 2-3 levels. Some people didn't like how sometimes it took 6-7 levels to learn a new skill.
[/olist]

[h3]Cosmic Apparition Rates[/h3]

We have tweaked the Cosmic apparition rate formula. The break down is:

[list]
[*]Starts at 1/4000 early-game.
[*]1/3500 mid-game.
[*]1/3000 late-game.
[*]-1 for each uniquely Seen monster (so up to -381).
[*]-2 for each uniquely Owned monster (so up to -762).
[/list]

That means that the best odds for a Cosmic spawn would be 1/1857 if you're lategame and own every Nexomon already.

There is a lot more going on in this update, but those were the highlights. Other things were:

[list]
[*]If your Nexomon faints and you switch, the enemy will no longer get a "free attack".
[*]Fixed a bug that would freeze the game if you picked the same language that you already had setup (e.g English to English).
[*]The quest "Tree of Gifts" was supposed to give you a Vault Key, but it didn't in earlier versions. If you had already completed the quest, this version will automatically award you a Vault Key in your inventory.
[*]The Dragon Whistles were having no effect on dragons.
[*]Added basic footstep sounds.
[*]Extra visual effects for caves.
[*]Various sound effects added or improved.
[*]Defeating a lower level Nexomon will now yield less EXP.
[*]Fixed an issue where if a status effect like Burn faints a Nexomon, they might still attack you in the next turn.
[*]Improved the skill selection of enemy bosses. Now it is less likely that they will use dumb skills against you, so be prepared!
[*]Cosmic Nexomon now have a glowing status box during battles.
[*]New players start off with 500 coins and a few potions and ethers to help kickstart their adventure.
[/list]

There is a lot more to do! And you can help us shape the future of the game with your feedback! Join our Discord server and share your thoughts now! https://discord.gg/bs659QD

-JVemon

notes.title: Beta improvements so far
notes.content:
Hello, beta testers! We've been closely reviewing your progress so far, and we are pleased to announce quite a few changes based on our observations.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]The game will now memorize the last skill slot you used during battles.
[*]You will now get bonus EXP for beating higher level opponents.
[*]Battles will yield many more coins.
[*]The shops have been visually revamped.
[*]We've tweaked the overall difficulty of Drake Isles onwards.
[*]Added sound effects to the Warpstone teleportation, and also updated its animation.
[*]The "demotivated" status effect used to last indefinitely. Now it lasts 2-4 turns.
[*]We've moved Trebly's second skill from level 8 to 7 as it took too long for new players to learn a new skill. We will also review and improve the slowness of skill-learning in general.
[*]Some storage consoles outside of Healing Centers were not obvious. We have added an icon on top of them.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you progress a lot in the story, certain monsters can become undiscoverable. This update ensures that they remain no matter how much you progress.
[*]The low health sound sometimes played before your HP bar actually got red.
[*]The playtime counter was being interrupted during battles, so the time logged in your profile is inaccurate. You'll have to check your Steam profile for a better estimate of your gameplay time.
[*]A small portion of Ignitia had no encounters.
[*]Gradow was completely undiscoverable. it has been added now.
[*]Secondary status ailments such as "frail" did not increase your capture chance.
[*]When replacing a skill with a new one, they didn't actually swap. Instead, the old skill was removed and then the new skill added to the top of the list.
[*]A few items were unreachable.
[*]A small section in Palmaya was walkable, despite having large rocks.
[*]If your Nexomon has "bind" or "planted" status effects, it means it cannot be swapped. However if it faints, you need to swap. Thus you would be stuck with a fainted Nexomon until the effects wore off.
[/list]

There is a lot more to do! And you can help us shape the future of the game with your feedback! Join our Discord server and share your thoughts now! https://discord.gg/bs659QD

-JVemon

notes.title: Meet all 9 Starter Nexomon and Choose Your Perfect Companion!
notes.content:
[h3]The story of Nexomon: Extinction starts with dramatic events that will throw you straight into the action! To help you act decisively and choose the perfect companion when the game is out later this summer, please meet the 9 starter Nexomon you will be able to chose from below![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/52f5105d0bb55dc14ea940f561d3fa52fadde799.jpg[/img]

[b]Element: Water 🌊[/b]
 
An amphibious flying Nexomon with heroic spirit. Its main characteristic is self-confidence and loyalty.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/909e1948957801576f6a2305001e8f24c6f9b5e4.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Element: Electric ⚡[/b]
 
A very curious Nexomon with the ability to walk on any surface with its sticky feet. They love to hide and stay hidden from others for long periods of time.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/c99acf3da513ef4002430b56ff1d6b4e5d017101.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Element: Ghost 🕯️[/b]
 
A ghost Nexomon that can be found in the darkness. They tend to detach their heads to scare their opponents.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/759afa9d04a2cae420671b87d1594732f604ab54.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Element: Fire 🔥[/b]
 
Not for those who love to hug their Nexomon. Lume's head, paws and tail are completely engulfed in flames.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/ec93f1bc476ad1f5118220beb7716390ac1f1681.jpg[/img] 

[b]Element: Psychic 🔮[/b]
 
People often confuse them as a ghost type Nexomon. Truth said, they are psychic Nexomon and have a somewhat obscure sense of humor.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/4c5953e7a4e61551276327cb7e6c2fa3df9b88b1.jpg[/img] 

[b]Element: Wind 🌪️[/b]
 
Mearns are not as friendly as they look. They are actually wild Nexomon that inhabit the prairies and mountain skirts. Their entangled tails can use wind to their advantage while hunting.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/7daab1d6f9fe86416421933b75e13a48bf507a10.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Element: Mineral ⛰️[/b]
 
They are always eager to prove the durability of their horns, they love to do headbutting competitions.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/d8030b0a20cc036376e0185d880aa0b000be1c89.jpg[/img] 

[b]Element: Plant 🌿[/b]
 
Maras are adorable and intelligent Nexomon who know how to use their charm in their favor during battles with tamers. Loves to be pet.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37772404/5d2d7925644f0f1288679ad0c265322dc89d8d71.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Element: Normal ⚪[/b]
 
Dinja features short legs, adorable big ears and a huge fluffy tail. Since they aren't good runners, they prefer to move by hopping their way.
